terra.problem: “Nothing” and “she only has to” misrepresent the passage: the LORD also commands His people to depart, touch no unclean thing, and purify themselves (Isa 52:11). Redemption without money means they cannot purchase it, not that God asks nothing of them. The paragraph also treats the specific promise to Zion as a direct promise that any reader will be freed from whatever situation makes them feel stuck.
